clauses.scope_note: LGPL-2.1 section 0: running a program using the Library is unrestricted by this License. Program output is covered by the License only if its contents constitute a work based on the Library; output is not automatically treated as a derivative. The text says whether that is so depends on the Library and the program.
clauses.condition_explanation: This records the express permission to run the program. The output-scope boundary is explanatory and does not independently create a permission or duty.
